faqs.question: Where can I find you?
faqs.answer: We're at card shows across the Vancouver area almost every weekend. Check the 'Find Us at a Show' section on our home page for upcoming dates and locations.

faqs.question: Do you ship cards?
faqs.answer: Not at the moment — we're currently show-only. Follow us on Instagram @jetlagged_cards for updates if that changes.

faqs.question: How do you price your cards?
faqs.answer: We price based on recent TCGPlayer market sales and PokeData. We aim to be competitive — if you find the same card cheaper somewhere reputable, let us know and we'll do our best to match it.

faqs.question: Do you buy cards?
faqs.answer: Yes! We buy singles, sealed product, and slabs. Bring your cards to any show or send us a message through the 'Sell to Us' page and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.

faqs.question: What condition do you sell cards in?
faqs.answer: We sell Near Mint (NM) and Lightly Played (LP) cards. Every card is inspected before it goes in the case. If a card has any notable wear we'll always disclose it.

faqs.question: Do you do trades?
faqs.answer: Absolutely — trades are one of our favourite parts of the hobby. Find us at a show and bring your trade binder. We're always looking for the cards on our want list.

faqs.question: Do you sell sealed product?
faqs.answer: Yes, we carry booster boxes, ETBs, tins, and blister packs at shows depending on what's in season. Stock varies so feel free to DM us ahead of time to check availability.

faqs.question: How do I get a vendor table at your shows?
faqs.answer: Head to the 'Our Shows' page and fill out the vendor application for the show you're interested in. Tables go fast so apply early!
